scenarios.scenario: Press a key on a selected staged command row

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows an initially empty Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" is staged with Large and Text unchecked
the user clicks the command name in the target row
its Large and Text checkboxes remain unchecked
the Part Tools target retains its pending-change marker
